dialogueSettings.text: The soil cut and soil stockpile contain real material. Dig or push a load, haul it to the fill platform, then grade thin lifts with the blade. Choose a shared job from Crew & jobs or operate the machinery manually.
Gravel starts in the marked live piles. Scoop and load it, tip it on the fill platform or push it with the bulldozer. The pile surface and volume change as material moves.

functionalSettings.prompt: Read Skyline Works · Crane, Earth & Crew

dialogueSettings.text: Build the city skyline in a 336 by 304 metre working yard. Enter the crane with E / Use, choose steel assistance or control the joysticks, and secure beams on the highlighted frame. Earthworks extend east and south: deep soil, loose gravel, stockpiles, a fill platform and full-size haul lanes. Crew & jobs lets workers use the shared machinery while you supervise or take control.

Crane controls: left joystick slews and runs the trolley; right joystick hoists. Lower the hook to the steel supply, attach a load, raise it, slew to the tower and lower onto the highlighted target. The server shares each movement and placed beam with everyone on site.

Park the excavator for its dig cycle, then position the truck five metres east of it to receive material. Drive loaded trucks along the haul loop to a spoil bay or the fill platform. Lower the bulldozer blade to push real soil and gravel. Stop before exiting; use Hide controls to clear the view.

name: Surface Mine · Quarry & Materials
label: Dig, screen, crush and supply your deed
description: A working surface mine with a six-metre pit, graded access ramp, gravel bank, topsoil stripping, two excavators, two haul trucks, a dozer, twin-deck screening plant, jaw crusher, transfer conveyor, radial stacker and six live product stockpiles. Process finite sand, fines, stone, crushed aggregate, seed-ready topsoil and mulch; stock, order and ship materials to owned deeds using shared freight and delivery inventories.

objects.name: SURFACE MINE · Mine → Screen → Crush → Ship

functionalSettings.prompt: Read SURFACE MINE · Mine → Screen → Crush → Ship

dialogueSettings.text: Drive down the ramp into the gravel pit. Scoop the bank, load a truck, haul to a marked feed bay and tip. The screen separates sand, fines, stone and topsoil; organic rejects become mulch. Feed screened stone through the crusher. Stack products, book them into the quarry warehouse and order real freight to your own deed.

functionalSettings.prompt: Read QUARRY OPERATIONS · Processing & Deed Freight

dialogueSettings.text: Open Quarry operations. Start or stop each plant, route screened stone to the crusher, use the stacker, book actual stock, select your deed and order shipping. The named AI operator can run the plant while you handle digging and hauling.

objects.name: PIT RAMP · Keep the centre lane clear

functionalSettings.prompt: Read PIT RAMP · Keep the centre lane clear

dialogueSettings.text: The pit is six metres deep. Follow the gently sloping centre ramp; do not drive over the banks. Raise and curl the bucket, lower the truck body and use Drive for travel.
Strip topsoil in shallow lifts and keep it separate from the gravel bank. Tip it into the screening feed bay. Screened topsoil is seed-ready; organic oversize becomes mulch for your deed garden.
